families.required_correspondence: Interpret each8/16/32/64-bit signed input in two's complement and round directly to binary64; no fp32 intermediate.
Interpret each8/16/32/64-bit unsigned input and round directly to binary64; no fp32 intermediate.
Bind binary16-to-binary32 extension including signed zero, subnormals, infinities and NaN/payload policy.
Bind bfloat16-to-binary32 extension including signed zero, subnormals, infinities and NaN/payload policy.
Bind binary32-to-binary64 extension including specials and NaN/payload policy.
Bind direct E4M3FN-to-binary64 tt.fp_to_fp, including finite-only format and NaN policy.
Bind direct E5M2-to-binary64 tt.fp_to_fp, including subnormals, infinities and NaN policy.

Bind direct f64-to-signed8/16/32/64 rounding toward zero on its exact finite/range domain. None is explicit outside that domain; native poison/traps are a separate structural gap. Bool output uses signed8.
Bind direct f64-to-unsigned8/16/32/64 rounding toward zero on its exact finite/range domain. None is explicit outside that domain; native poison/traps are a separate structural gap.

Bind direct f64-to-binary32 truncf with specified rounding/overflow/underflow/NaN policy.

Bind direct f64-to-E5M2 tt.fp_to_fp RTNE, including subnormal/overflow/infinity/NaN policy.
Bind binary64 addition with exact rounding, signed-zero, subnormal/flush, overflow, infinity and NaN behavior for the intended target configuration.
